text:
mina: Quick thread for NovaML onboarding. They want a tiered distribution model: hosted tile + gated download for enterprise + partner-hosted (SI) option. Need legal/export + ops gating checklist.
alec: gated download = customers must sign MSA + complete attestation and we provision a per-customer KMS key?
partner-nova: yes, we can do per-customer key wrapping and provide OpenKey v4 + cosign signatures. We prefer 'download-restricted' SKU.
courtney: legal: what indemnity/redistribution language do we need for gated downloads? partner is EU-based (NL) and asks to cap indemnity to insurer limits.
legal-bot: marketplace policy requires explicit redistribution flag: "no-download", "download-restricted", or "download-sublicensable". For gated downloads we accept capped indemnity if partner supplies E&O + cyber insurance and a takedown SLA. Also need export classification statement. I'll open ticket EX-7202.
ops-bot: ops checklist snippet:
```
- model: NovaML-8B
- version: 2026-06-01
- artifacts: [weights.tar.gz, runner.cosign.sig, manifest.pgpsig]
- download_flag: download-restricted
- attestation_flow: SAML + signed attestation
- kms_flow: per_customer_wrap
- telemetry: aggregated_only
- geo_block: ["CN","RU"]
```
mina: marketing note: partner requests co-announcement and 10-business-day embargo after contract sign. They want logo + quote approval.
partner-nova: we'll provide approved quote and logo SVGs; 48h turnaround on copy review.
courtney: operationally we need an extra metadata field for entitlement_evidence_url and a pointer to insurer binder. Also need assurance on SLSA provenance for the runner.
partner-nova: will upload SLSA attestation and insurer binder by Thu EOD. We'll also provide a signed build trace.
alec: pricing / rev-share ask: partner proposes sliding rev-share for downloadable SKU: 65/35 partner/redwood up to $X, then 50/50 beyond. Finance will need audit rights on usage reports.
courtney: finance: audit clause OK if partner agrees to quarterly reports and standard audit window. I'll draft appendix.
legal-bot: opened EX-7202 (export classification) and PL-7203 (indemnity + audit appendix). Target Fri EOD for initial review.
mina: timeline proposal:
- Thu: partner uploads provenance + insurance
- Fri: legal initial ok (PL-7203) and export check (EX-7202)
- Mon: ops create staging tile, gate download flag behind legal clear
- Two weeks after partner signoff: publish + co-announce (per embargo)
ops-bot: I'll create staging tile with canary routing for SI-hosted path and set downloadable SKU to blocked until legal flips flag.
mina: action items recap:
- @partner-nova: upload SLSA + insurer binder by Thu EOD
- @legal-bot: review indemnity + export by Fri EOD (PL-7203 / EX-7202)
- @ops-bot: staging tile + gate download flag
- @alec: draft rev-share appendix for finance
If anything blocks, flag here and we can escalate. Thanks! :handshake:
